decisions.reason: The 2024 UAT page mixes trade and cashflow scenarios with populated trade and package identifiers, a named issue tracker, ADO references, test observations, and defect outcomes. Retain the page as test evidence without treating it as current target intent. Its expiry scenarios describe an upstream trade-expiry gate; the related Cashflow Events Control page describes RATAN handling for an expiry event. Ask whether these rules compose and remain current.
